excerpt: No more re-entering IPs, ports, or password. Everything is saved, so you connect instantly.
if you configure a jump host for a Group, every Host within it will automatically connect through that jump host
Items in the Keychain can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them.
You can broadcast a command to all sessions simultaneously and save the entire setup as a reusable template.
execute them on multiple hosts at once from the Snippets screen
Termius can convert a plain-language description into a shell command... Termius generates the command using AI.
Termius automatically collects terminal session logs for every host. Logs are synced across devices and shared with your team. You can search logs and save them using Bookmarks.
Every account includes a Personal vault, accessible only to you and synced across all your devices.
When you add team members, a Team vault is created automatically. This vault is shared with all team members, allowing your team to manage infrastructure together.
Collaborate in the terminal in real-time using the multiplayer sessions. Troubleshoot together or guide teammates through your workflow.
With autocomplete suggestions for frequently used commands, arguments, and file paths, you can save time and focus on more important things.
Create and manage your SSH keys with passphrase protection. Everything is encrypted and easily accessible from any device.
Secure SSH authentication with FIDO2 security keys and MFA.
Secure connections with device-bound keys and biometric protection with Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics.
Termius doesn't depend on the cloud to manage your access. Your infrastructure is stored and encrypted locally. Connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN.
Connect securely to remote infrastructure with just one click from any device and collaborate with your team in an encrypted cloud vault.
You only need to configure the machine once and then you are able to connect to it in multiple ways without duplicating settings.
For example, if you configure a jump host for a Group, every Host within it will automatically connect through that jump host.
When a password changes, update it in the Keychain once. Every Host that references it automatically picks up the change.
You can run them from the side panel, trigger them via autocomplete, or execute them on multiple hosts at once from the Snippets screen.
Termius can convert a plain-language description into a shell command. Press the Down Arrow in the terminal, describe what you want to do, and Termius generates the command using AI.
Termius syncs your hosts across iOS and Android, keeping them available on all your devices.
Make your team view the latest terminal sessions on any host, regardless of who connected, for easier task handovers, collaboration, and audits.
You can also create additional vaults to separate data and control access across different team members or environments.
User used Termius's saved snippets plus shell scripts to do quick monitoring/admin tasks instead of building web dashboards, calling it easier than an interactive webpage.
Longtime Server Auditor/Terminus user recounted debugging bouncing Docker containers from an iPhone while on vacation without a laptop, praising free Mosh support as 'a huge plus.'

Termius on Windows desktop 'falls short of the usability threshold' due to slow performance at high resolutions when scrolling large text, worse than gnome-terminal or Terminal.app; issue persisted across multiple version checks.
User expressed wariness about using closed-source Termius for sensitive SSH tasks, asking for details on cryptography libraries and security steps taken, none of which were easily found.
'I've been a longtime user, I love it! Its a must have on all of my devices.'
'Great app but the ability to remap caps lock to Esc on an external iPad keyboard is why I went with Blink shell instead.'

User praised Termius pricing page but flagged a discrepancy: landing page claims 24,000 and 300,000 engineers use it in the same section, while pricing page says 10,000, calling it credibility-damaging.

'I'm a hobbyist at best, so the subscription is not justified or useful for me (plus I just don't like subscriptions). I wish you guys had some intermediate product that allowed a one-time contribution.'

Network engineer using Termius on Mac for about a year complained he can't scroll with mouse and select text, forcing him back to Mac Terminal for log collection; also wants connections list always visible.
'187MB for an installer! What extra do we get instead of Putty/Other SSH Clients to justify this humongous size!? Can't size be slimmed down!'
User said he has not used the Termius mobile app because he is 'skeptical to store the hostnames and IPs (and definitely passwords) on a third party application.'

'Termius on Windows is slow and buggy in my experience... It's also yet another subscription, cheapest being $8.33 per month which is more than Microsoft Office... we're not using the software' due to pricing; prefers VanDyke's SecureCRT/FX for better support.
Commenter noted a downside of Termius is 'being able to store your SSH keys on Termius' servers,' as a security concern versus alternatives like SecureCRT.
'I haven't tried the Terminal Sharing feature yet but I have found Termius to be one of the best SSH clients on iOS and iPadOS.'
